snippet.title: Roller Riot Trailer
snippet.description:
MassDiGI SIP19 trailer for Roller Riot game.

Crazy cyborgs are causing chaos in the city and have made their way towards the Roller Derby District. You are the last one standing. Punch, kick and roll your way through a frenzy of different enemies hell bent on taking you down. Show them that you are a force to be reckoned with and that they chose the wrong street. And don’t forget to use your cyber upgrades to take down more enemies! Coming soon.

2019
